title: Reference breakdown, loop check, delivery scripts
what_it_does: breakdown.py (cuts, rhythm, contact sheet of a reference video), loop_check.py (first vs last frame difference), deliver.sh (downscale 4K and normalise loudness), screen_track.py.
when_to_use: Studying a reference; verifying a seamless loop.
why: loop_check is the useful one for loops (under about 3 means seamless). breakdown.py is handy but its output is of other people's videos, so keep it git-ignored as they do.
